row: 金門國家公園成立於1995年10月18日，面積約35.3平方公里，分為太武山、古寧頭、古崗、馬山與烈嶼五區。園區有瓊林、珠山等閩南聚落與僑匯興建的洋樓，以及古崗湖等湖泊；記錄到的鳥類多達319種。

title.en: Academies, Old Houses and a National Park

tagline.zh-Hant: 從朱熹講學到戰地，再到國家公園
tagline.en: From Zhu Xi's lectures to a war zone and a national park

zh: 金門國家公園成立於1995年10月18日，
是縣內解除戒嚴後的第三年。
en: Kinmen National Park was founded on 18 October 1995,
three years after martial law ended in the county.

zh: 面積約35.3平方公里，
約占全縣的四分之一。
en: It covers about 35.3 square kilometres,
roughly a quarter of the county.

zh: 宋代學者朱熹曾在燕南書院講學，
這裡是金門最早的文教之地。
en: The Song scholar Zhu Xi taught at Yannan Academy,
Kinmen's first seat of learning.

zh: 講學帶動了讀書風氣，
明、清兩代，金門出了不少進士。
en: His teaching inspired a love of study:
in the Ming and Qing Kinmen produced many top graduates.

zh: 太武山頂坳處的海印寺，建於宋代，
已有八百多年歷史。
en: Haiyin Temple, in a col near the top of Mount Taiwu,
was founded in the Song, more than 800 years ago.

zh: 珠山是薛氏的單姓聚落；
祖先在元代從廈門來此定居，已有約650年。
en: Zhushan is a village of the Xue clan alone;
their ancestors came from Xiamen in the Yuan, some 650 years ago.

zh: 瓊林是金門規模最大的古厝聚落，居民多姓蔡；
「瓊林」是明熹宗御賜的里名。
en: Qionglin, home of the Cai clan, is Kinmen's largest old village;
the Ming emperor Xizong gave it its name.

zh: 明末，鄭成功與幕僚
曾在太武山上的這處岩洞觀兵弈棋。
en: At the end of the Ming, Koxinga and his staff
reviewed troops and played chess at this rock cave on Mount Taiwu.

zh: 明魯王為了反清復明，在金門停留十多年；
古崗湖南側山上的石刻，刻於1652到1654年間。
en: The Ming Prince of Lu stayed on Kinmen for more than ten years to resist the Qing;
his inscription on the hill south of Gugang Lake dates from 1652-1654.

zh: 後浦人丁興旺，康熙年間，
總兵署便從舊金門城遷到後浦。
en: Houpu was thriving, so in the Kangxi years
the garrison headquarters moved here from old Kinmen city.

zh: 莒光樓被視為金門的精神象徵，
把傳統城樓放在現代建築的基座上。
en: Juguang Tower is seen as a symbol of Kinmen:
a traditional gate tower set on a modern base.

zh: 烈嶼的勝利門，原址曾立著
紀念1958年八二三砲戰的紀念碑。
en: Victory Gate on Lieyu stands where a memorial
to the bombardment of 23 August 1958 once stood.

zh: 東北角的天摩山，早年是軍方的觀測所，
如今已開放為步道。
en: Tianmo Mountain in the north-east, once an army observation post,
is now open as a walking trail.

zh: 書院、古厝、戰地，
一層層歷史疊在同一座島上。
en: Academies, old houses, a war zone:
layer upon layer of history on one island.

tagline.en: Minnan houses, the examination god and the salt pans

zh: 金城舊稱後浦，
是金門的政治與經濟中心。
en: Jincheng, once called Houpu,
is the political and economic centre of Kinmen.

zh: 金門過去不是縣，不能建孔廟；
鄉賢便建奎閣，供考生祭拜魁星。
en: Kinmen was not a county and could not build a Confucian temple,
so local worthies built this tower to the god of examinations.

zh: 朱子祠立於清康熙二十六年，1687年，
設在浯江書院內。
en: The Zhuzi Shrine was set up in 1687,
inside the Wujiang Academy.

zh: 在瓊林，只要有人考中進士，
就會建一座宗祠。
en: In Qionglin, whenever someone passed the highest examination,
the family built another ancestral hall.

zh: 瓊林大大小小的宗祠，多達六座。
en: Qionglin has six ancestral halls, large and small.

zh: 清末到民國，許多金門人渡海到南洋等地謀生，
俗稱「落番」。
en: From the late Qing onwards many Kinmen people crossed the sea to South-East Asia to make a living,
known as luofan.

zh: 少數成功的人把僑匯寄回家鄉，
興建「洋樓」光宗耀祖。
en: The few who prospered sent money home
to build Western-style houses that honoured their families.

zh: 歐陽鐘遠洋樓建於1918年，
是金門第一幢洋樓。
en: The Ouyang Zhongyuan house, finished in 1918,
was Kinmen's first Western-style house.

zh: 屋主在新加坡、馬來西亞經商致富，
才把錢寄回故鄉蓋樓。
en: Its owner made his fortune trading in Singapore and Malaysia
before sending the money home to build it.

zh: 珠山位在金門本島的西南方，
是環島西路的起點。
en: Zhushan lies in the south-west of the main island,
where the West Ring Road begins.

zh: 西園鹽場展示金門
約七百年的製鹽產業。
en: The Xiyuan Salt Field tells the story
of some 700 years of salt making on Kinmen.

zh: 烈嶼的東林東井開鑿於1204年，
是金門最大的古井。
en: On Lieyu, the Donglin East Well was dug in 1204,
the largest old well in Kinmen.

zh: 初訪金門的人，
常會登上莒光樓遠眺。
en: First-time visitors
often climb Juguang Tower for the view.

zh: 宗祠、洋樓與鹽場，
記錄著離鄉與返鄉的金門人。
en: Ancestral halls, Western houses and salt pans
record the people who left Kinmen and came back.

tagline.zh-Hant: 湖泊、林地與三百多種鳥
tagline.en: Lakes, woods and over three hundred kinds of birds

zh: 亞熱帶氣候與稀少的人口，
讓金門成為候鳥從秋到春的中途站。
en: A subtropical climate and few people
make Kinmen a stop for migrating birds from autumn to spring.

zh: 國家公園一帶，
記錄到多達319種鳥。
en: As many as 319 species of bird
have been recorded around the park.

zh: 古崗湖是金門目前唯一的天然湖泊，
四周有梁山、紅山與大帽山環抱。
en: Gugang Lake is the only natural lake left on Kinmen,
ringed by Liangshan, Hongshan and Damaoshan.

zh: 湖邊的草坪上，
常能看到臺灣本島見不到的戴勝。
en: On the lakeside lawns
hoopoes, never seen on Taiwan itself, are common.

zh: 慈湖是金門人公認看夕陽的好地方；
1969年築起的慈堤，把海與湖隔開。
en: Ci Lake is where locals go to watch the sunset;
a dike built in 1969 separates it from the sea.

zh: 從高處俯瞰，雙鯉湖
就像兩條相環的鯉魚。
en: Seen from above, Shuangli Lake
looks like two carp curled around each other.

zh: 蘭湖由蘭林水庫轉型而來，1968年完成，
集水面積達125公頃。
en: Lan Lake began as the Lanlin reservoir, finished in 1968,
with a catchment of 125 hectares.

zh: 榮湖截取金沙溪水而成，建於1972年；
湖畔種滿防風林。
en: Rong Lake was made by damming the Jinsha stream in 1972;
windbreak trees line its shores.

zh: 太湖北岸的榕園，
百年古榕的氣根粗壯，枝葉交織成綠傘。
en: On the north shore of Tai Lake, the Banyan Garden's century-old trees
drop thick aerial roots under a green canopy.

zh: 雙鯉湖與慈湖一帶生態豐富，
常有成群的水鳥聚集。
en: Around Shuangli and Ci lakes wildlife is rich
and flocks of waterbirds gather.

zh: 太武山腳下的金門植物園，
收集了兩百多種華南與金門原生植物。
en: At the foot of Mount Taiwu, Kinmen Botanical Garden
holds more than 200 South China and native plants.

zh: 秋天，往陽明湖的路旁，
臺灣欒樹盛開。
en: In autumn the Taiwan golden-rain trees
bloom along the road to Yangming Lake.

zh: 烈嶼的西湖是一座寬闊潔淨的湖泊，
和蘆葦叢生的陵水湖完全不同。
en: West Lake on Lieyu is a wide, open lake,
quite unlike reed-filled Lingshui Lake.

zh: 從秋天到春天，
候鳥在這些湖泊與林地間停留。
en: From autumn until spring
migrating birds stop among these lakes and woods.

tagline.zh-Hant: 太武山、天然湖與東方的岩岸
tagline.en: Mount Taiwu, a natural lake and the rocky east coast

zh: 金門國家公園分成五個區：太武山、古寧頭、
古崗、馬山與烈嶼。
en: Kinmen National Park has five areas: Taiwu Mountain, Guningtou,
Gugang, Mashan and Lieyu.

zh: 太武山從遠處看，像一位仰臥的隱士，
民間稱為「仙人偃地」。
en: From afar Mount Taiwu looks like a hermit lying on his back;
locals call it the immortal at rest.

zh: 太武山後山，
露出紅色的花崗岩。
en: On the back of Mount Taiwu
red granite shows through.

zh: 步道兩旁巨石嶙峋，
有些岩塊長得像動物。
en: Boulders crowd the trails,
some shaped like animals.

zh: 海印寺建在太武山頂的山坳裡，
古稱太武巖寺。
en: Haiyin Temple sits in a hollow near the top of Mount Taiwu,
once called Taiwu Rock Temple.

zh: 天摩山海拔約63公尺，
是金門東北角的制高點。
en: Tianmo Mountain, about 63 metres high,
is the highest point of the north-east corner.

zh: 復國墩位在金門島的最東端，
沿海是花崗岩隆起的陡峭岩岸。
en: Fuguodun is the easternmost point of the island,
a steep coast of uplifted granite.

zh: 古崗湖是島上唯一留下的天然湖泊；
榮湖、蘭湖則是人工興建的。
en: Gugang Lake is the only natural lake left;
Rong and Lan lakes were built by people.

zh: 榮湖截取金沙溪水而成，
是金門的五大湖之一。
en: Rong Lake dams the Jinsha stream
and is one of Kinmen's five large lakes.

zh: 西北岸的慈湖，
靠一道海堤與外海隔開。
en: On the north-west shore, Ci Lake
is held apart from the sea by a dike.

zh: 金沙鎮的西園鹽場，
記錄著金門的製鹽歷史。
en: The Xiyuan salt field in Jinsha
records Kinmen's long history of salt making.

zh: 往西飛向烈嶼；
上林海灘可以眺望對岸的廈門。
en: Flying west to Lieyu:
from Shanglin Beach you can see Xiamen across the water.

zh: 烈嶼，也稱小金門，
是國家公園的一部分。
en: Lieyu, also called Little Kinmen,
is part of the national park.

zh: 花崗岩的山、湖與岩岸，
撐起這座島的地形。
en: Granite hills, lakes and rocky shores
give this island its shape.
